label: Dingy Closet
literalRoomDescription:
This is a dingy closet adjacent to a larger room to the north. Chiselled into a wall are these words:

     Protected by
       FROBOZZ
 Magic Alarm Company
  (Hello, footpad!)

There doesn't seem to be any footpad here, however.
safeSceneProfile: Dingy alarm-company closet; carved warning follows source text. Steel cage is separate and initially concealed, not a permanent central cage.
